# Upstream source

Kitsuri Studios UnpairCore, commit f581d81681aad66cd484b3629b7159898a1462cb,
https://github.com/Kitsuri-Studios/unpaircore. The source files are unchanged except for whitespace normalization.
This is an experimental replacement for libpairipcore.so. It includes a no-op
ExecuteProgram and hooks which may alter game or telemetry behavior. Its
compatibility with Minecraft 1.26.66.1 is unknown. GamePwnage-derived source
retains its original file headers; both license notices are packaged in assets.
